prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Move towards and take object if visible. Else, explore and scan surroundings.     list of available nodes: <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Action ID = MoveToDesignatedLocation    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectFragile    /> <Action ID = AdjustGripStrength    /> <Action ID = PerformSubTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsAreaMapped    /> <Action ID = MoveToUnexploredArea    /> <Action ID = ScanEnvironment    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveToDesignatedLocation
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectFragile? THEN
			DO AdjustGripStrength
	ELSE
		DO PerformSubTask
	END
